description: Detects HTTP requests to user-controlled URLs that can reach internal services or cloud metadata endpoints. Use when writing code that makes HTTP requests to URLs constructed from user input, fetches resources from caller-specified addresses, or proxies requests on behalf of users. Also invoke when implementing webhook receivers or URL preview features.
